prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one universal “best” — the best dentist for a dental implant in Atlanta depends on your needs (complexity of the case, bone/gum health, sedation needs, budget, prosthetic goals). For dental implants you should usually be looking at experienced oral & maxillofacial surgeons, periodontists, or prosthodontists rather than a general dentist (unless that general dentist has strong implant credentials).

What to look for
- Specialty and credentials: board-certified oral surgeon (AAOMS), board-certified periodontist (ABP), or prosthodontist (ABP). Memberships in AAID or ICOI are also relevant.  
- Experience: number of implants placed, experience with cases like yours (single crown vs. full-arch, bone grafting, sinus lifts).  
- Technology: cone-beam CT (CBCT) imaging, digital implant planning and guided surgery, intraoral scanning.  
- Restorative coordination: a skilled restorative dentist/prosthodontist working with the surgeon for the final crown/prosthesis.  
- Before/after photos and patient references.  
- Complication/failure management and warranty/guarantee policy.  
- Comfort options: sedation or IV anesthesia if you need it.  
- Reviews and referrals: from your general dentist, other patients, and independent review sites.  

How to find and verify
- Ask your regular dentist for referrals (they do restorations after implant placement).  
- Use professional finders: American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons (AAOMS), American Academy of Periodontology, American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID), or ADA Find-a-Dentist.  
- Check Google/Yelp/Healthgrades for patient feedback and before/after photos.  
- Verify board certification on the appropriate board websites.  

Questions to ask at a consultation
- How many implants have you placed? How many like mine?  
- Are you board-certified? What are your specialties?  
- Do you use CBCT and guided implant surgery?  
- Who will do the crown/bridge that goes on the implant? Can I see before/after photos?  
- What is the total cost (implant, abutment, crown) and what might raise that cost (bone graft, sinus lift)?  
- What is your failure/complication rate and how do you handle failures?  
- What sedation options do you offer? What is the expected timeline from placement to final crown?  

Typical cost range (Atlanta, general ballpark)
- Single implant with crown: often $2,000–$5,000+ depending on grafting, implant brand, and restorations. Complex cases (full-arch, bone grafts) are more. Get itemized quotes.

- Provide a short list of highly rated implant specialists in Atlanta if you tell me your zip code or neighborhood (I can’t browse live, but I can suggest how to search and what names to prioritize), or  
- Draft an email or phone script you can use to contact clinics and compare quotes.
